info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Compliance Management API
info.description: The Regulatory Compliance Management API provides resources related to banking regulatory compliance. This API allows users to access and retrieve compliance data based on specific parameters. Typical consumers include compliance officers, financial institutions, and regulatory bodies seeking to ensure adherence to legal requirements. By utilizing this API, organizations can manage their compliance documentation and monitor regulatory changes effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific regulatory compliance identified by its ID. It helps ensure that you have the necessary compliance data at your fingertips for informed decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a GET operation for the regulatory compliance resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the payload is structured according to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, returning the requested data.

GetRegulatoryComplianceByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to regulatory compliance.

submissionId.description: The unique identifier for the submission.

legalEntityId.description: The identifier for the legal entity involved.

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction under which the compliance is assessed.

reportingPeriod.description: The period for which the reporting is done.

dueDate.description: The due date for compliance submission.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record.

version.description: The version of the compliance record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the compliance record.

GetRegulatoryComplianceByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing compliance regulatory response for a specific operation.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The identifier for correlation in tracking events.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Metadata providing additional context regarding the compliance record.

bearerAuth.description: Utilizes the Bearer Authentication scheme, which involves a security token (JWT) transmitted in the HTTP Authorization header. This allows clients to securely authenticate and authorize API requests.
